parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh-CN and en-US. Default value: zh-CN. The value zh-CN indicates Chinese and the value en-US indicates English.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the authentication rule.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse list-auth-policy --biz-region cn-shanghai --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source edasmsc --protocol SPRING_CLOUD --name auto-rule-00 --app-id jgy4cadmqo@000 --namespace default --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ListAuthPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --AppId 'jgy4cadmqo@000' --PageNumber 1 --Region 'cn-shanghai' --AcceptLanguage zh --Protocol SPRING_CLOUD --Source edasmsc --Namespace default --Name 'auto-rule-00'
